visual_base.visual_narrative_log:
(1) A young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and straight bangs stands inside what appears to be a fitting room or a private domestic space. She is dressed casually in a teal blue t-shirt with a small white graphic on the chest and high-waisted white cargo-style trousers. She begins by meticulously adjusting her hair behind her ears with both hands, then transitions into a confident pose with her hands placed firmly on her hips while smiling at the camera. The background consists of heavy dark brown curtains and a wooden rack with partially visible hanging garments. The lighting is soft, warm, and originates from an overhead indoor source.
(2) The subject leans her torso forward, bringing her face into a close-up perspective. She extends her right arm and hand directly toward the camera lens, with her palm facing forward as if to press against the glass or cover the view. This deliberate movement creates a physical transition between the initial setting and the following scene. Her expression is focused and playful as she interacts directly with the camera's physical space.
(3) The scene shifts to a bright, open retail environment, possibly a themed boutique or a large bookstore. The woman is now transformed, wearing a traditional cream-colored kimono decorated with delicate pink and lavender floral patterns, secured by a wide patterned obi belt. She holds a transparent cup filled with a yellow beverage. Overlaid on the frame are white graphical elements mimicking a camera viewfinder, including a red REC indicator, battery icon, and technical exposure settings. The background features clean white shelves stocked with colorful magazines and books.
(4) The camera frames her in a medium close-up as she sips her drink through a straw. Behind her, a white wall is decorated with a neon yellow sign that reads 'Make it'. Animated graphics of small white and yellow flowers float around her face, blinking on and off. She maintains a cheerful and engaging demeanor, looking directly into the lens. The lighting here is significantly brighter and more even, typical of a modern commercial establishment.
(5) In a final wide shot within the same retail space, the woman performs a joyful spin, allowing the fabric of the kimono to move and show its full silhouette. She then walks forward toward the camera with a bright smile. To her right, a white pillar prominently displays a black and white sign with the words 'TAIWAN STATION' in a bold, sans-serif font. The bookstore-like environment continues in the deep background with visible shoppers and various display racks.
